pages.text: One breezy afternoon, <name> ran to the field with his new kite. But as soon as he held it, the kite wiggled and wiggled.
“Hello!” it squeaked. “I’m Kiko, the talking kite! Come with me — I’ll show you a hidden garden!”
<name> gasped. A kite that talked! He held the string tight, but a playful breeze tugged Kiko high into the sky.

“Whoa! Wait!” <name> laughed, chasing after it over puddles left from last night’s rain. Splash! His shoes got wet, but he didn’t mind. The kite looped and twirled, giggling as it led him to a tiny hill.
<name> climbed up carefully, wobbling but determined. At the top, the breeze finally calmed. Kiko landed gently and pointed his string toward a thicket of flowering bushes.
<name> pushed the branches aside and gasped in delight — a hidden garden glowed with colorful flowers, sparkling streams, and fluttering butterflies.
Kiko twirled in the air. “See? Patience and curiosity can lead to magical places!”

<name> smiled, brushing the wet hair from his face. He realized that sometimes, chasing adventure with a little patience and a lot of curiosity brings the most wonderful surprises. From that day on, whenever the wind blew, <name> and Kiko soared together, always searching for the next hidden wonder.
